game.title: Silent Exit
menu.subtitle: Move quietly. Save who you can.
intro.title: Before the quiet
intro.body: You once wondered what you would do if panic filled a place you knew. Tonight there is no heroic speech, no weapon, and no easy answer. There is a locked building, one frightened civilian, and a way out if you move quietly. Find a badge, watch the patrol, use sound carefully, and lead them out.
settings.title: Settings
credits.title: Credits
credits.body: Silent Exit is a first playable vertical slice. External and generated assets are listed in ASSET_CREDITS.md.
pause.title: Paused
objective.move: Find the badge and a quiet way through.
objective.distract: Throw an object to draw the patrol away.
objective.rescue: Find the civilian and bring them to the safe zone.
hint.move: WASD to move. Mouse to look.
hint.crouch: Press Ctrl to crouch and move quietly.
hint.pickup: Look at a small object and press E to pick it up.
hint.throw: Left click to throw. Right click to drop.
hint.rescue: Press E near the civilian to guide them.
hint.exit: Bring the civilian into the teal safe zone.
minimap.title: Floor Plan
level.fail: You were spotted. Try again quietly.
